CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: mapeditor: added a real edit command for in-place object field edits (position/material/seed/extents), preserving the object's own index and carve bounds -- previously remove+add would silently break any per-object damage state keyed by index; verified live including overlap-warning and error paths; README.md and NORTHSTAR.md updated (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
